source_update.description: Video analysis of the overnight appearance of the 7 July 2007 OM 7-7-7 formation in East Field was added to the archive video collection.

observed: A dated archive update identifies a dedicated video analysis of the formation's overnight appearance.
The source concerns temporal appearance evidence rather than a new geometric interpretation.
The archive also provides a growing provenance corpus containing photographs, contemporaneous reports, surveys, geometry, and scientific research.

inference.statement: If the underlying video preserves a sufficiently bounded time interval and stable landmarks, the formation can be treated as a temporal state-transition experiment rather than only a static geometry.

cc_os_test.name: temporal_state_transition_replay
nulls: ordinary human construction performed during an unobserved interval
cc_os_test.promotion_rule: No temporal mechanism is promoted without original media provenance, frame-level replay, and independent extraction.
